build_FillerbusterData: build a FillerbusterData dataloader with configurable multi-view and single-view dataset ratios and patch settings
build_multi_view_dataset: build a multi-view dataset combining Shutterstock3D and ScanNet++ datasets with configurable sampling probabilities
build_single_view_dataset: build a single-view ImageDataset for training on individual images with GPU disabled
synchronized_next: get the next synchronized batch across all GPUs for a given training step without mixing view types
get_total_samples: get the total number of samples across all active multi-view and single-view datasets
